_about: Forestry (https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Forestry). Recorded values are from rsprox 227/00083, 01723, 01850, 01855 and 237/01098 (Leagues worlds, so their XP and bark are inflated and not used); Wiki values are marked; calibrated ones are guesses.
_trees: Wiki: overworld trees except regular, burnt, hollow, player-grown, blisterwood and the Woodcutting Guild's. Achey and Dramen trees are left out too (calibrated).
_spawn: Wiki: an event needs a forestry kit among the choppers, none within 30 tiles of another, 40-120 s between events; rewards need a chop within 30 tiles in the last 3 minutes. Recorded: the first event 19-29 ticks into chopping, a log the tick before each spawn, the spawn stops the chopping. Wiki: an event comes at a random point on the tree's timer, or when it falls. Calibrated: 20-200 ticks of chopping before an event unless the tree falls first, and the 40-120 s buffer as 67-200 ticks from the end of the last.

sapling._progress: Wiki: the sapling's max HP is 900 a player, at most 9,000; recorded: the hitsplat is 0.6 x the nutrition, success after 16 full feeds solo.
sapling._feed: Units per nutrition, as the recorded bark and XP scale (10/20/40/50/60/70/100 -> 1/2/4/5/6/7/12); bark is units less 0-1 (recorded 3, 4, 6-7, 11-12; Wiki 1-12). XP at 100% (Wiki): Woodcutting 1.9-2.2 x level, Farming 0.6-0.8 x level, scaled by units/12.
sapling._lump: Wiki: bonus bark by average nutrition; recorded 177, 162, 191. Bonus XP is calibrated (the Wiki's formula is garbled): 50 x level x average nutrition. Leaves: Wiki 15-20 of the tree's tier.

roots._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t7914-8120: six roots at the start within 4 tiles, each at a random rotation, with sound_area 7002 (range 4) on its tile; a wave every 21-29 ticks (28, 26, 27, 29, 21, 29, 24) that deletes the 2-4 roots which sank 7 ticks before it (the last wave's anima root always among them, sound_area 7007 range 2 on each) and raises as many, one anima from the second wave on, so six always stand; at 199 ticks every root sinks, deleted 7 ticks later. Chop down gives 'You swing your axe at the roots.' and the axe anim, the anim again 2 ticks on and every 4 ticks after, a bark award the tick after each; the root stays until the event deletes it (7-8 awards a root, none failed).
roots._rewards: Wiki: normal roots 2-3 bark (Woodcutting 15-40) or 3-4 (41+), anima roots 8-10 or 11-13; XP 0.55 x level a normal root, 1.2 x level an anima root, each award. Calibrated: an award a chop at the willow's chance (live never failed one, maybe a Leagues effect).

pheasant._recorded: rsprox 227/00083 t19147-19347, 01855 t7421-7621, 237/01104: the Freaky Forester, three pheasants and four nests (nest01 49936 / nest02 49937, each flipping every 8 or 12 ticks), Retrieve-egg on a nest with the pickup seq, one egg at a time, half the time a feather too, the attack and stun, the hand-in, 'These pheasants will be finding new nesting grounds soon.' at 181 ticks, all gone at 200. Wiki: 8-9 bark an egg (9 at 9/10), Woodcutting 1.0-1.2 x level and Thieving 0.5 x level an egg. Inferred: nest01 is the occupied form; clicking it, or the nest a pheasant is flying to, brings the attack.

poachers._recorded: rsprox 227/01855 (six runs), 00083, 237/01100, 01101, 01108: the fox and three poachers with their spawn sounds; the first trap 4-8 ticks in, then one every 10-17, set on the arming poacher's own tile 2 ticks after its seq (map_anim 2343, sound 2386); the fox crawls (a tile every 2 ticks) to the oldest trap and springs one it has stood on for 2 ticks unless it is being disarmed (the fox's defend seq, a 34 hitsplat, sounds 7541 and 2387 a tick later, the trap gone 2 ticks after); the disarm (9 ticks, synth 2387 at the start and end, the trap's seq and a poacher's complaint a tick before the end, the end line as spam); the end at 200 ticks with the poachers' lines, sounds 7538 and 2386 at the tree, synth 7531, and the lump a tick after the saved line. Wiki: up to 15 traps, a sprung trap takes 33-34 of the fox's 100 HP, 11 bark a trap, Woodcutting 1.5 x level and Hunter 0.5 x level a trap, 160 bark and 400 + 14.45 x level Woodcutting XP at the end, and the failure line.

ritual._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t6292-6535 (8 of 8 steps), 01855, 01723 (4 steps): the Dryad, five ritual circles within 3 tiles a step, the odd one (its colour and its shape both unique among the five) to stand on, a step every 30 ticks scored at 27, the end after eight. Wiki: 20-21 bark a step, 2 x level + 60 XP a step, 2 x steps x level + 55 at the end; recorded lumps 143/144 for 8 steps and 72 for 4 (about 18 a step). 01850 also: sound 7540 at the Dryad as she comes and goes, each circle's spotanim (2583-2598) as a map_anim where it appears with sound 7549 at the tree, headbar 17 on the Dryad every 5 ticks and as a step is scored (fills 0-60 over eight steps), the scorer's circle spotanim and synth 7535 with the step's bark, synth 7531 at the end; chatheads chatquiz1 (player) and chathap2 (Dryad).

flowering._recorded: rsprox 227/00083, 01850, 237/01104 and 01108: eight bushes (each its own colour) and two bee npcs; Tend-to with the pickup-table seq; exactly two bushes active at once as a pair; a pair closes every 70 ticks from the spawn (sound_area 818 at both its bushes) and the event ends at 299; collecting is synth 2581 with the pollen; applying is synth 2427 and the pollen gone, then the tick after the seq again, synth 2581, the pollen back and the bark; either bush of a closing pair may fruit (synth 7014, the line counting that pair's fruiting bushes), is removed 15 ticks later (map_anim 2369) and grows back in that colour on another tile 10 ticks after that (spotanim 2369); at the end the bushes go (map_anim 2369), the dormant and discard lines the tick after, the lump the tick after that, growing with the fruiting bushes. Wiki: 1-2 bark an exchange, the lump about 0.75-0.85 x the bark collected, 1-8 strange fruit. Calibrated: XP (the Wiki's formula is garbled) as 0.2 x level + 2.8 an exchange and 10 x level a fruiting bush at the end; the fruiting chance, 10 of 31 pollinated bushes fruiting over the recordings at about 7 applies each.

entlings._recorded: rsprox 237/01104, 227/01723, 237/01098: five entlings with their requests overhead, Prune's menu (Top/Back/Sides/Cancel) and Prune-top/-back/-sides, 'You prune the entling.' with the pruning seq and bark a prune, 10-22 prunes an entling, the pruned form and its thanks, the stun for pruning it again or the wrong cut, 'Almost time to go!' at 155, the end at 200 with the gift. 01104 also: sound_area 7533 at each entling as it appears; they wander, each calling every 4-7 ticks; synth 2440 with the prune line and the bark the tick after; a finished entling turns the tick after its last prune with spotanim 2571 and sound_area 7553; the stun the tick after the click with spotanim 254 at height 124, synths 2565, 2727 and 7547 and chathead chatscared1; at 199 the despawn seq, map_anim 2369 and sound_area 7540 at each, gone the tick after; the haircuts line with synth 7531 three ticks after the despawn and the gift the tick after it. Wiki: the leafy mullet is top and sides; 4-5 bark a prune; XP 0.5 x Woodcutting and 0.2 x Fletching level a prune; 25 bark, 4 leaves and 3 x level Woodcutting XP for each fully pruned entling at the end; a 3 s stun. Calibrated: 10-20 prunes an entling, split over the areas it wants.

beehive._recorded: rsprox 227/01855 (two runs), 237/01104, 01098: the bee keeper ('Oh, Bees!'), an unfinished beehive and the wild one, two bee npcs; Build adds logs one every two ticks with the pickup seq, filling headbar 17 by 12 of 60 a log (five logs solo); the box changes at 36 and is complete at 60; the completion line, then a bark lump the next tick, sometimes sturdy beehive parts; a new box within 3 tiles with a smoke puff, the old one gone 4 ticks on; the keeper's lines; over at 250 ticks. Also recorded: smoke (map_anim 1180 at height 124) with sound_area 1930 at the keeper (range 7) and the first box (range 5), and 7529 (range 5) at the wild hive as they come; Build opens skillmulti (14) 'How many logs would you like to add?' with the first log type and how many are carried; the pickup seq on the choice and on every log but the last, the logs going the tick after the choice and every two ticks, each with its bark and synth 7543, 7548 or 7554; on the last log the box turns complete with sound_area 7536 and 3046 (delay 50) and one of the keeper's three lines; the tick after the completion line, the parts (line, item and synth 2655) and the new box (smoke and 1930); the lump the tick after that; the old box gone 5 ticks after the last log with smoke and 1930; refusals as item boxes with logs ('You have no logs to build this beehive.', 'The hive is complete...'); Talk-to with chatheads chatquiz1 and chathap2; the keeper leaves at 249 with smoke, 1930 (range 7) and 7531 (range 10), the rest at 250. Wiki: 5 logs a player (at most 50) a hive; 2-3 bark a normal log, 4-5 an oak, 5-6 better; Woodcutting 40% / 55-60% / 75-80% and Construction 20% / 30% / 40% of level a log by the same tiers; 25-30 bark and 5.45x - 0.02x^2 Woodcutting XP a hive; parts 2/3 of the time.
beehive._tiers: Wiki (Beehive (Forestry event)): regular and achey 40% / 20% / 2-3 bark; oak, willow, teak, maple, jatoba and mahogany 55-60% / 30% / 4-5; arctic pine, yew, camphor, ironwood, magic, redwood and rosewood 75-80% / 40% / 5-6. Juniper is not in the Wiki's table and keeps the top tier.

done: Come with me little bees I'll keep you safe.
I'll find a nice new home for those bees.
lines.bye: Well, I must be getting on now.

talk:
Hello, it seems you've found a wild beehive. I'll pay you
to help me rehome them.

It's easy, simply add logs to the unfinished bee boxes I
create. Most common types of log work just fine.

Once a bee box is completed I will start a new one, let's
see how many of these bees we can save.

leprechaun._recorded: rsprox 227/01850 t8623-8924 (and 00083, 01723, 01855, 237/01104, 01098): the Woodcutting Leprechaun on a clover by the tree ('It be yer lucky day, Foresters!'), with smoke (map_anim 1180 height 124) and sound_area 1930 (range 5) on his tile as he comes and goes; a rainbow loc at a random rotation within 1-9 tiles every 37 ticks from the first tick, sound_area 7545 (range 7) as it comes, its despawn anim and 7544 (range 7) 17 ticks on, deleted at 20; standing in one: 'You feel more in touch with the trees after standing in the rainbow.', spotanim 2580 and synth 7551, 12 added to varbit 15344 (the luck: 0->12, 2->14, 3->15, 4->16), and 15343 set to 6 minus the rainbow's number (6 at the player's first contact with him); each log then spends 5 of it: 'You use your leprechaun's luck to gather some Anima-infused bark.' (spam; the last, leaving under 5: 'You use the last of your leprechaun's luck...', a game message) and 22-23 bark the tick after; the luck outlives him (spent after he left, kept across logins); Talk-to and Bank (the menu, no animation for options 1-2, the deposit box, 'Some of your items cannot be stored in the bank from here.'); 'I'll have to go shortly...' at 186, 'Well, I must be getting on now.' at 223, gone at 224. Wiki: six rainbows; a luck log's XP about 1.33 x level + 38.7 more [confirmation needed]; he banks everything for those who were chopping, else only woodcutting resources.

lines.start: It be yer lucky day, Foresters!
lines.talk: Grand job, what an obnoxious tree, spreading rumours 'bout other trees and sucking up all the water.
lines.talkBank: As a reward, I'll let ye use me full banking services!
lines.bye: Well, I must be getting on now.
